verdict.rationale: TaxJar ships a documented REST API with official clients covering tax rate and category lookups, order transaction upload, nexus region listing, and address and VAT validation. However, UI capabilities such as AutoFile return filing and remittance, the economic nexus threshold tracking tool, and reporting are not shown to be available through the API, so parity with the UI is not established. Missing for 10: API access to AutoFile filing and remittance, API access to nexus threshold tracking and reporting, any documented statement of UI/API parity, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
